## Context

Project `poc-multi-module-arch-hexagonal-springboot` (by wesleyosantos91) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.mapstruct:mapstruct-processor` from `1.4.2.Final` to `1.5.0.Final` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/wesleyosantos91/poc-multi-module-arch-hexagonal-springboot/pull/8

## Your Task

The source code is in `/poc-multi-module-arch-hexagonal-springboot`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
